title: RentGuard Renters Policy Conditions — Renewal, Late Renewal and Nonrenewal
content:
## Renewal

A RentGuard Renters Policy that is in force and not under a notice of nonrenewal is renewed for twelve calendar months when renewal installment 1 is paid by the expiration date, at the annual premium rated under the annual premium rating rule on the renewal offer date. Otherwise it expires, with the reason renewal not paid.

## Late renewal

- A late renewal payment is accepted only when it is received no later than the late-payment window that starts on the expiration date.
- The window is counted in calendar days from the expiration date shown on the policy record; its last day is the expiration date plus the tier's late renewal payment period.
- A late renewal starts the new term on the day the payment is received, with no coverage between the expiration date and that day.
- A policy that expired under a notice of nonrenewal is never renewed late.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical; expiration 1 August, late-payment period 15 days).** A renewal payment received on 16 August, the last day of the window, is accepted and the new term starts on 16 August, leaving 1 to 15 August uncovered. One received on 17 August is not accepted.

## Nonrenewal by the company

The company nonrenews only when, on the notice date, the paid claims are at or above the tier's paid-claims threshold, and only with notice sent at least the tier's minimum nonrenewal notice period before the expiration date.

The paid claims are the number of distinct claim numbers on the customer's renters policies that have at least one claim payment, not voided, issued within the tier's claims lookback window — that many calendar months ending on the notice date.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| In force, no nonrenewal notice, renewal installment 1 paid on or before the expiration date | renewed for twelve calendar months |
| In force, no nonrenewal notice, renewal installment 1 not paid by the expiration date | expires, renewal not paid; a late payment inside the window renews it with a gap |
| Under a notice of nonrenewal | expires at the expiration date and is never renewed late |

**Hypothetical count.** A customer has two RentGuard policies. Claim 1 on the first policy had a payment 20 months before the notice date; claim 2 on the second had two payments 5 and 6 months before it; claim 3 had one payment that was voided. With a 36-month window the paid claims number 2: claims 1 and 2 count once each, and claim 3 does not count.
